TradePositionDoc.title: TradePositionDoc
TradePositionDoc.description: An active open trading position owned by a specific authenticated user.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this position.

isBuy.description: True for BUY order, false for SELL order.

currentPrice.description: Latest market price for this position.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when position was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when position was last updated.

HistoryTradeDoc.title: HistoryTradeDoc
HistoryTradeDoc.description: A closed historical trade deal owned by a specific authenticated user.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this history record.

symbol.description: Trading instrument symbol (or 'WDR:<comment>' for withdrawal entries).

isBuy.description: True if the closed position was a BUY, false if SELL.

lots.description: Closed volume in lots (0.0 for withdrawals).

profit.description: Realized profit or loss in USD (negative for withdrawals).

openTime.description: Encoded string: 'openTime|sl|tp|ticketId|hitCode' for trades (hitCode: 1=SL, 2=TP, 0=none), or 'closeTime|ticketId' for withdrawals.

swap.description: Swap fee applied to the deal.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when history entry was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when history entry was updated.

AccountDoc.title: AccountDoc
AccountDoc.description: Trading account summary and profile settings for an authenticated user.

realizedProfit.description: Total realized profit across closed trades.

accountName.description: Display name on the trading account.

isReal.description: Whether the badge displays Real or Demo.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account doc was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when account doc was updated.

/users/{userId}/positions/{positionId}.description: Active open trading positions scoped to a specific user.

/users/{userId}/history/{historyId}.description: Closed historical trades scoped to a specific user.

/users/{userId}/accounts/{accountDocId}.description: Account balance and profile settings scoped to a specific user.
